sources.entry: Posato - Blocks the websites and apps you choose for a timed pause, now or on a schedule, with optional end-to-end encrypted sync to iPhone through iCloud.

summary.one_liner: Posato is a cross-platform app that blocks chosen websites and apps for a timed pause, started now or on a schedule, with optional encrypted sync across devices.
summary.what_it_does: Posato lets you group websites and per-device apps into pause sets, then start a timed pause from 5 minutes to 24 hours, or until end of day. During a pause it blocks the chosen websites and apps on that device, within platform limits. Schedules can start and end pauses automatically by weekday and hour, and you can skip or end one early. Pause sets can sync through iCloud between one Mac and one iPhone, or through a folder you choose (such as Dropbox or Syncthing) that receives only encrypted files, linking Mac, iPhone, Linux, and Android. A one-time export to a password-protected .posato file copies pause sets without app choices. The README states there is no Posato account, analytics, or Posato-operated server.
use_cases: block distracting websites during work hours
schedule recurring focus time on a Mac or iPhone
pause apps for a set duration
share focus settings between Mac and iPhone via iCloud
block sites on an Ubuntu computer
block websites and apps on an Android phone
move blocking settings to another device
how_to_run: Mac: download the signed and notarized DMG from GitHub Releases and move Posato to Applications.
iPhone: install Posato from the App Store.
Linux: download the .deb from GitHub Releases and run sudo apt install ./posato_<version>_<arch>.deb.
Android: download the .apk from GitHub Releases, allow installing from this source, and install.
To build from source, follow the build instructions in the repository documentation (unsigned builds explore the apps; blocking and sync need Apple Development signing).
stack: Swift (implied by Apple platform apps; not explicitly named)
Apple Screen Time controls on iOS
notable: Works across macOS, iOS, Ubuntu Linux, and Android, with Windows planned later
End-to-end encrypted sync via iCloud or any user-chosen folder service; data is encrypted on device before storage
Schedules run on their own on each device, even with the app window closed on a computer
Overlapping pauses stay in effect until the last pause that includes an item ends
No account, analytics, or Posato-operated server, per the README
caveats: Explicitly described as adding friction, not an unbreakable lock; restrictions can linger on iPhone after a session ends, and pauses under 15 minutes clear only when the app is opened.

Mac website blocking covers only Safari and Google Chrome Stable via the system proxy; Linux blocking can be bypassed by browsers using their own DNS over HTTPS; Android blocking is bypassed by strict Private DNS or browser DNS over HTTPS, and another VPN cannot run during a pause.
Sync is best effort, and if every copy of the workspace key is lost, synced data cannot be recovered; pull requests are not currently accepted.
